GLIBC-SA-2026-0024 (CVE-2026-97399) is a one-byte overread in the Power8-specific strncasecmp optimization (BZ #34683). DHI pkg-glibc rebuilds target linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only, so that Power8 implementation is not present in published glibc debs. See https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0024

DHI rebuilds prevent a failed direct-buffer gzwrite from leaving a caller-owned input pointer available to gzprintf or gzvprintf. The +dhi4 rebuild applies the pointer-state reset from upstream commit https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 in the equivalent zlib 1.3.1 error branch; +dhi3 guards the later formatting entry points. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091.
